claim: Historical three OBJ outputs reproduce byte-for-byte from the original Git blob with path-only adaptation.
conditions: Baseline v0.1.0; IDs 10/1000/2000; original input hashes
counterexamples: Does not establish reconstruction accuracy or portability to other dependency versions.
next_action: Keep baseline immutable; reproduce any changed environment.

claim: Concave footprint substitution alone is not safely compatible with the original roof assembly.
conditions: Concave hull ratio .20, simplification .05 source units, fixed development20
counterexamples: 11 improved; this does not reject concave boundaries in general.
next_action: Test bounded plane support and conforming assembly; do not add ID-specific exceptions.

claim: Excluding bytecode and preserving release bytes in Git retains 1388 snapshot-file hashes across Git archive.
conditions: Three r2 research releases; Windows packaging
counterexamples: A matching hash establishes integrity, not algorithm quality.
next_action: Use -B for frozen execution; verify subsequent archives.

claim: Demo roof-only data and 26 geometry-filtered derived solids do not supply independent facade or complete-building mesh ground truth.
conditions: User confirmed roof-only demo_dataset on 2026-09-21; walls/base were inferred
supersedes: stage01 interpretation of derived meshes as general building-training candidates
counterexamples: Original roof wireframe can still support roof-structure debugging.
next_action: Acquire independently supplied full meshes with observed facade returns; retain prior files as roof-only experiments.

claim: Low observed P95 cannot validate unseen completion, official scores or recursive improvement.
conditions: No complete GT, no formal fixed-model multi-seed feedback comparison
counterexamples: Known complete GT and E7 transfer can test different claims.
next_action: Use full meshes, fixed evaluator and independently grouped transfer tasks.

claim: Downloaded author-paired real/simulated ALS and independently screened facade evidence; 78 starter pairs retain source geometry and author split.
conditions: Point2Building Zurich 28415 pairs; strict-closed stratum 71/228 qualifying; PolyGNN mini simulated 199/200 qualifying
counterexamples: Most raw reference meshes are not watertight under this audit; partial ALS does not cover every facade; quality-selected samples are not an unbiased benchmark.
next_action: Use real pairs for facade diagnostics, synthetic pairs for controlled checks; preserve full author test population for declared evaluation.

claim: The upstream Point2Building loader derives additional bottom-plane points from reference mesh height; these are not raw sensor measurements.
counterexamples: The downloaded raw XYZ can be used directly without that preprocessing, as done in this audit.
next_action: Separate author-preprocessing reproduction from XYZ-only experiments; do not allow GT-derived input features in the latter.

claim: Complete audit of all 1087 topology-qualified Point2Building pairs retained 363; independent Blender checks and file integrity checks passed. Project split is 312 train / 51 sealed test.
conditions: Fixed facade criteria, source geometry unchanged, 56832 extracted files hash-verified; original 28415 pairs preserved.
counterexamples: Nonadjacent BVH does not prove absence of all self intersections; quality selection does not represent the complete real distribution.
next_action: Develop only on frozen starter78, document stability and freeze code before full-set evaluation.

claim: All 18 qualified author-test buildings are in starter78, hence not unseen after development. New project holdout51 is drawn from author-train with spatial and shape groups isolated.
conditions: Original author splits retained separately; project holdout selected without reconstruction predictions.
counterexamples: Author pretrained Point2Building weights may have seen this project test subset; no cross-city claim.
next_action: Retrain comparison methods under project split or use a separately declared author benchmark; keep full-set manifests stage-locked until starter stability.

claim: Unified local collection includes all qualifying Zurich real pairs (363) and all qualifying downloaded PolyGNN mini simulated pairs (199), with separate evaluation strata and stage-locked full manifests.
conditions: User explicitly limited this round to downloaded mini. Raw synthetic 402 files hash-verified; 199 independent Blender checks passed. Project train432/test130 includes starter78 only in train.
counterexamples: Mini is not the upstream full Munich release. Normalized synthetic units cannot be pooled with real source-unit distances; synthetic spatial isolation is unproven.
next_action: Develop on unchanged starter78, retain per-source reports, unlock full collection only after documented stability and version freeze.

claim: 562 paired samples were standardized with an input-only invertible transform and passed roundtrip checks.
conditions: Only affine normalization, unchanged point order/count; neither GT-defined transform nor ground-point injection.
counterexamples: Bounding-box scale is outlier-sensitive; QA does not establish reconstruction quality.
next_action: Keep protocol version fixed and test normalization sensitivity later.

claim: Failure-gated roof recovery recovered six starter buildings while common-success metrics stayed identical; a separate no-feedback footprint proposal improved geometry.
conditions: Single proposal and seed; 78 development pairs; source-stratified paired evaluation.
counterexamples: One F3 failure remains; no-feedback geometry gains mean the result does not prove F3 universally better.
next_action: Separate recovery, geometry and their interaction in repeated controlled proposals.

claim: The policy distilled from discovery24 and selection24 did not improve same-start transfer30 outcomes over the original Harness.
conditions: Both policies proposed one modification; same initial code and evidence content, inherited model configuration.
counterexamples: This single null result does not disprove other policy designs; both candidate activation hypotheses failed to change measured outcomes.
next_action: Diagnose candidate support and failed activation directly, then preregister another independent transfer trial.

claim: 图像条件的候选较文本知识候选共同成功CD/ECD均值降低，但单提议多算子不足以证明图像因果。
conditions: 相同初始代码、discovery24文本与知识，FULL实际看2图；精确Token不明。
counterexamples: FULL与F0/v0.5.1仍有指标取舍，知识组相对无显式知识几何有退化。
next_action: 多次独立提议，同等信息与成本控制。

claim: 真实屋顶Z有信息，但最低回波不能确定建筑底高；禁止绝对Z阈值推断立面高度。
conditions: starter78真实38/仿真40，参考Mesh最低面作为比较对象。
counterexamples: 真实37/38最低回波高于参考底面超2%；mini可有低端噪声。
next_action: 引入可信地面/地形证据或明确底高不确定性。

claim: FULL关闭相对临时底面角点检查后78份OBJ相同，本批可测贡献为0。
conditions: 同一代码仅关闭一个检查，固定评测/输入。
counterexamples: 零激活不证明异常输入下规则无效，也不能宣称恢复真实底高。
next_action: 独立异常输入压力测试，保持固定验收。

claim: NumPy2.5.3二维cross兼容异常导致原T全部失败，等价修复必须与反馈收益分开。
conditions: 原候选及失败保留；T一处、TK两处代数等价修复，rawTK未评测。
counterexamples: 兼容修复后的可运行性不能归因为知识或图像。
next_action: 后续固定依赖/API约定并预留相同兼容检查预算。

claim: 官方推荐保存函数对空顶点/面创建空OBJ；批量提交必须分开报告占位数和成功网格数。
counterexamples: ZIP本地格式通过不代表平台已接受或重建精度高。
next_action: 有限官方验证，保留失败并区分三角面与原多边形面统计。
